recognize_zh: 四格染色中，散在的大型非典型細胞 CD30 與 CD15 呈細胞膜加核旁高基氏體（Golgi）點狀陽性，EBER 原位雜交只標在大細胞核上，而 PAX5 在大細胞比周圍小 B 細胞弱；這組「CD30+/CD15+、PAX5 弱陽」是古典何杰金淋巴瘤的典型免疫表型。
features: Scattered large atypical cells in a background of small lymphocytes
CD30: membranous and paranuclear Golgi-dot staining of the large cells
CD15: similar membrane plus Golgi pattern in a subset of the large cells
EBER ISH: dark nuclear signal restricted to scattered large cells
PAX5: weak nuclear staining in the large cells compared with strongly positive small background B cells
describe_en: Immunohistochemical and in situ hybridization studies on a lymph node show scattered large atypical cells in a background of small lymphocytes. The large cells are positive for CD30 and CD15 with membranous and paranuclear Golgi-zone accentuation, and EBER in situ hybridization highlights nuclei of the large atypical cells. PAX5 shows weak nuclear expression in the large cells, dimmer than in the admixed small reactive B cells. This immunophenotype (CD30+, CD15+, dim PAX5+, EBV+) is characteristic of Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, and the findings support EBV-positive classical Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: LP cells are CD30-/CD15-, strongly PAX5/CD20/OCT2+ and EBV negative.
ALCL shows sheets of uniformly strong CD30+ hallmark cells, usually PAX5 negative with T-cell or cytotoxic markers and EBV negative.
These have large cells with strong CD20, PAX5, OCT2 and BOB1 and usually lack CD15.
IM contains numerous EBER+ cells of varying size including small lymphocytes and CD30+ immunoblasts that are CD15 negative with strong B-cell markers, in a preserved architecture.

stain: IHC: CD30, CD15, PAX5; ISH: EBER
